purpose: Pinned audited withdrawal of two stored Adobe reports counted against a version the report is not about: the Premiere Pro version a project was created in, and the Acrobat Reader version an update started from. Every row is kept; only counted and exclusion_reason change.

edit.evidence_valid_for_current_patch: not present on these rows; a block carrying it refuses

adjudication_packet.note: A label-free shuffled packet of stored text: the two rows and six counted controls drawn by a rule fixed before the draw (three per product, one on each row's own page that must stay counted). The brief named no row and stated no hypothesis.

basis: A row is here only when TWO independent blind adjudications, each made from the stored text alone without the first audit's labels, the selection key or each other's labels, labelled it INCORRECT for the credited version: second_blind and third_blind. first_audit is the corpus measurement that proposed the row; it is recorded as provenance and is not one of the two determinations. Each row takes the closed reason both blind reviews support. The tool grants these two identities and no other row of either product.
note: Each entry must match exactly one stored block whose sha256 equals block_sha256_before (to withdraw) or block_sha256_after (already withdrawn). No retain entries: neither is a duplicate.
